name: Justinian's Gothic War in Italy
summary: Justinian's Gothic War (535–554) destroys the Ostrogothic kingdom after 20 years of fighting that devastates Italy. General Belisarius's initial brilliant campaigns capture Rome and Ravenna; the Ostrogothic resurgence under Totila recaptures most of Italy; Narses finally destroys the Goths at the Battle of Busta Gallorum (552).

_quarry.structural_significance: The war kills more Italians than the original barbarian invasions; the destruction of the senatorial aristocracy ends Roman urban culture; Italy is so weakened that the Lombards conquer it within 14 years.
